Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 v_check_digit VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 --RP Task# 167 05032028
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) NOT IN (7,13) and :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID = 'M'
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID := '';
 show_error('1190');
 --message('Unit Length mut be 7 or 13 Characters.');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 --Make sure user enter only Alpha Numeric only. Check A -> 65, Z -> 90, 0 -> 48, 9 -> 57
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID = 'M' then
 FOR i in 1..length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID) LOOP 
 if ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 65 and 90 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 48 and 57
 then
 null; 
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID := '';
 show_error('5193');
 --message('Unit mut be Alpha Numeric Characters only.');
 EXIT;
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) >= 13 then
 --Check digit should be populated for ISBT/for unit less than 13 digits -- 05082018
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := v_check_digit;
 end if;
 end if;
 --Task# 167
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count1 from arc_log_det
 where
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 if temp_count1 > 0 then
 show_error('0214');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id := '';
 end;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 -- there cannot be situation where the
 -- chapter_id is not there but the collection
 -- date is there
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 if :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id is null
 then
 show_error('0191');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 nvl(chapter_id,nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX')) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX') and
 nvl(coll_date,trunc(sysdate)) =
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,trunc(sysdate));
-- and
 -- cancel_flag is null;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.utrs := 'N';
 else
 :GLOBAL.utrs := 'Y';
 end if; 
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 -- and
 -- nvl(chapter_id,nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX')) =
 -- nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX') and
 -- nvl(coll_date,trunc(sysdate)) =
 -- nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,trunc(sysdate));
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_test_base := 'N';
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_test_base := 'Y';
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.utrs = 'N' and
 :GLOBAL.unit_test_base = 'N'
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0206');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 nvl(chapter_id,'XX') =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX') and
 nvl(coll_date,trunc(sysdate)) =
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,trunc(sysdate));
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_attrib := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_attrib := 'N';
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 nvl(chapter_id,'XX') =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,'XX') and
 nvl(coll_date,trunc(sysdate)) =
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,trunc(sysdate));
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_inter := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_inter := 'N';
 end if;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 v_local_time date;
 lv_chapter_id varchar2(10);
 
begin
 
 begin 
 select
 chapter_id
 into lv_chapter_id
 from sample_shipment_det
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and rownum =1;
 exception 
 when others then 
 null;
 end;
 
 
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_Date is not null then
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 if lv_chapter_id is not null then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(lv_chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 end if;
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 begin
 
 if trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) > trunc(v_local_time) then -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 show_error('0060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date);
 if temp_count != 1
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :utrs.s_sl_no := :system.trigger_record;
 if :utrs.test_mode = 'M'
 then
 :utrs.s_test_mode_desc := 'Man';
 end if;
 if :utrs.test_mode = 'A'
 then
 :utrs.s_test_mode_desc := 'Auto';
 end if;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :utrs.s_result_1_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL' and
 code = :utrs.result_status_1 and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :utrs.s_result_2_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL' and
 code = :utrs.result_status_2 and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct testing_lab_code
 into :utrs.testing_lab_code
 from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = :utrs.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :utrs.test_chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 -- V06
 
 /* commneted out as part of the MLT-2267 
 -- IM:8628
 -- Added on 05/15/2012; Timezone conversion code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:utrs.result_dats, :utrs.s_result_dats);
 else
 :utrs.s_result_dats := :utrs.result_dats;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
*/

 If :utrs.test_mode='M' or :utrs.program_id='RTURLOAD' then 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:utrs.result_dats, :utrs.s_result_dats);
 else
 :utrs.s_result_dats := :utrs.result_dats;
 end if;
 Elsif :utrs.test_mode='A' and :utrs.program_id!='RTURLOAD' then 
 :utrs.s_result_dats := :utrs.result_dats;
 End If; 


 
end;
